falsification_conditions.condition: The ETF's price closes below the 200-day moving average by at least 5% within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakdown below key support would invalidate the pattern's structural integrity and contradict the HOLD signal.

falsification_conditions.condition: Trading volume surges to 200% above the 30-day average volume on a single day within the 14-day window
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Excessive volume would indicate a blowoff top or panic selling, directly contradicting the current HOLD and blowoff score of 60.

falsification_conditions.condition: The ETF's relative strength index (RSI) crosses below 30 (oversold territory) and remains there for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained oversold condition would signal a potential reversal invalidating the pattern's continuation and HOLD signal.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
